scope: Official source search help, role options and map client; no model predictions or scores.

findings.subject: taxonomy
findings.finding: The live source search explicitly lists roadside settlement and jetty, omitted from the CSV minor lookup. Both are preserved in the crosswalk, with no market/authority inference.

findings.subject: start_censoring
findings.quote: Start date: Date of commencement of activity within the excavated area. Note that sites beginning in the middle Iron Age or earlier will show as ‘-100’.

findings.subject: end_convention
findings.quote: End date: Date of cessation of activity. Note that an end date of 400 is given when sites are described as ‘continuing until the end of the Roman period’.

findings.subject: function_timing
findings.quote: Please note, that these dates apply to the settlement phasing, not individual features.

findings.subject: map_client_only
findings.finding: Official client map projection is EPSG:3857, display projection EPSG:4326, and includes EPSG:27700 definition. This establishes client CRS only; no use of CSV X_REF_MAP/Y_REF_MAP traced, so exported CRS and positional precision remain unresolved.

findings.subject: record_vs_place
findings.locator: Layer descriptions refer to records classified by type
findings.finding: Map categories include records rather than independent, dated institutions. Association components only conservatively block related records; no physical-place merge is established.
